title: Giant Rush 3D
description: Sprint down vibrant 3D obstacle lanes, collect same-colored stickmen to bulk up into a towering colossus, smash through brick walls, and KO the rival boss at the finish.
controls: Drag left and right to steer your runner through matching color crowds, dodge hazards, and tap rapidly in the final boss clash.

zh-CN.title: 奔跑吧巨人 3D
zh-CN.description: 全球超休闲亿级爆款奔跑吧巨人：赛道吃同色小人疯狂变大变强，撞碎障碍一路狂飙到终点一拳打飞大 Boss！
zh-CN.controls: 按住左右滑动吸收同色小人壮大体型，躲避异色陷阱并在终点连点暴揍巨型 Boss。
